name: slip
description: Slip is a browser-native Markdown slide editor focused on single-file authoring and reliable print/PDF output.

scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check src/*.js && node --check server/*.js
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:v1 && npm run test:v2 && npm run test:v3 && npm run test:v4
scripts.test:v3: node --test tests/cloud-auth.test.js tests/cloud-connectors.test.js tests/google-drive-connector.test.js tests/one-drive-connector.test.js && playwright test tests/v3-cloud-auth.spec.js
scripts.test:v4: node --test tests/share-model.test.js tests/share-server.test.js tests/ai-prompts.test.js && playwright test tests/v4-share-ui.spec.js tests/v4-ai-tools.spec.js
